[SWS_CM_00810] Method to unsubscribe from a service trigger
⌈
Inside
the specific Trigger class belonging to the specific ServiceProxy class a Un-
subscribe method shall be provided to allow for unsubscribing from previously sub-
scribed triggers.
void Trigger::Unsubscribe();
If the Trigger is not subscribed to at the time of the call, Unsubscribe() shall return
silently without any action.
⌋
